Finnish Satellite Startup Iceye Launches $2.3 Billion Bid for Rocket Maker Avio

Iceye also pledged to invest more than $1 billion in Italy over five years, in addition to Avio’s investment plans

By

Finnish satellite operator Iceye launched a $2.25 billion takeover bid for Italian rocket maker Avio as it seeks to build an integrated European space and defense company.

Iceye—recently backed by Europe’s new technology fund—said the continent’s need for sovereign space and defense capabilities is growing, noting that it is critical to invest now as building industrial capacity to meet demand takes years.
